title: A six-action Signal Observatory visit
provenance: Executed against the actual Elsewhere Worker in an isolated SQLite test world. A documentation fixture, not a production visitor or an enjoyment study.
scope: Selected action requests and game response fields. Guest credentials, identity IDs, events and concierge payloads omitted. The final two status labels summarize successful rest and checkout responses.
replay: With operator permission, check in, use the returned private guest token, and submit each request separately to POST /api/act. Use fresh action keys, read each response, and wait at least one second between actions. Each new instrument selects a random rule, so outputs can differ.

hypotheses.label: First and last symbols are equal
The number of A symbols is even (including zero)
At least two identical symbols are adjacent
There are more A symbols than B symbols

response.instruction: Choose informative experiments. There is no time limit or score.

response.discovery: The number of A symbols is even (including zero)
response.reflection: Which experiment separated your closest hypotheses? No response required.
